conversation.text: Molo Rumi! Ndisandula ukugqiba isifundo sezandi neBanga loku-1.
conversation.en: Hello Rumi! I have just finished the phonics lesson with Grade 1.

conversation.text: Molo titshala! Ndiyavuya ukuva kuwe. Sihambe njani isifundo sezandi namhlanje?
conversation.en: Hello, teacher! I am happy to hear from you. How did today's phonics lesson go?

conversation.text: Sihambe kakuhle, kodwa abanye abafundi basabhidanisa isandi esitsha 'tsh' nesandi 'sh'.
conversation.en: It went well, but some learners still mix up the new sound 'tsh' with the sound 'sh'.

conversation.text: Oko kuqhelekile. Ngomso, qala ngemizuzu emihlanu yokuphinda izandi: biza isandi, abafundi basiphinde, emva koko basibhale emoyeni. Emva koko hlanganisa amagama amafutshane afana nelithi tshona.
conversation.en: That is common. Tomorrow, start with five minutes of sound revision: you say the sound, the learners repeat it, then they write it in the air. Then blend short words such as 'tshona'.
Thank you, I will try that tomorrow.

conversation.text: Wenza umsebenzi omhle kakhulu, titshala. Ukuphinda yonke imihla kuyanceda. Sesiphi isandi oza kusifundisa kwiveki ezayo?
conversation.en: You are doing very good work, teacher. Revising every day helps. Which sound will you teach next week?
